name: terraform-lone-lock-file-undetected
body: Language detection matches the Terraform claim by file-name suffix, but its walker skips every dot-named entry, files included, so a repository whose only Terraform file is `.terraform.lock.hcl` is not detected as terraform; a real configuration always carries `.tf` files beside its lock file, so detection is unaffected in practice. Upgrade when a lone lock file must trigger detection: admit dot-named files to the walker for the candidates that claim a dot-prefixed suffix, without also admitting dotfiles such as `.eslintrc.js` to the other languages.
